meta.title: A Morning at the Small Zoo

paragraphs: A Morning at the Small Zoo, posted by Mia. On Saturday, the Explorers visited the small zoo in our town. It is a local place, and many families go there. I took the photos, because I love animals. A man at the zoo met us at the gate. "Welcome!" he said. "Today you can help me with an activity." Teacher Kim came with us, and the sun was bright. We were excited, so we listened carefully.

The man showed us a big empty bowl. "This bowl is empty, but the monkeys are hungry," he said. "We make a fruit mix for them every morning." "It is my job, and I love my career." The monkeys watched us from a tree, and they looked hungry. Leo laughed, but I took a photo. He gave us a card with a simple recipe. The recipe had four ingredients: bananas, mangoes, apples, and a little water.

First, Leo and May washed the fresh fruit in a big sink. Then the man cut it into small pieces, because the knife was big. I put the pieces in the bowl, and May added the water. Leo mixed everything with a long spoon. Everything was fresh, so the smell was lovely. May counted the pieces, and there were many. "It smells sweet!" said Leo. We carried the bowl to a table near the monkey house.

We stood behind a low wall, and the man put the bowl on the grass. The monkeys ran to the bowl. It was like a race! A small monkey started first, but a big monkey was faster. The monkeys shared the fruit, because there was enough for all. I took many photos, because the monkeys moved fast. "This is a good race for the blog!" said Leo. Soon the bowl was empty again, and the monkeys sat in the sun.

"Why did you choose this career?" asked May. "I like animals, and I like to work outside," said the man. I want to feed animals, too, but I also want to take photos. Maybe I can do both. The man smiled and said, "Come again next month." We thanked him, and then we walked to the bus. What career do you want?
